signal: Scrut Automation raised $10M to add generative AI to its GRC platform and expand across North America and Europe

email.body1:
Tyler, saw Scrut raised $10M to add generative AI to the GRC platform and expand across North America and Europe.

Multi-market expansion usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where good pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Scrut off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tyler, quick follow-up for Scrut.

Opening new geographies tends to push the pipeline target ahead of what headcount can cover, especially across three markets at once. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Scrut needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tyler, last bit of proof for Scrut.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Scrut's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tyler, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline across markets without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and a multi-region expansion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-market motion? I'll tailor it to Scrut either way.
